% An article with minitoc's tables of a section and of a part, beside
% the numbered files of an earlier build that loaded xcolor, in minitoc's
% own format: each entry has \textcolor, and xcolor is not loaded here.
% Under tex4ht, the first section's tables read the files of index 2, and
% \parttoc reads the file of index 0, so the stale .ptc1 is a guard. The
% stale files stay as they are.
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{minitoc}
\begin{document}
\doparttoc
\dosecttoc
\dosectlof
\dosectlot
\tableofcontents
\listoffigures
\listoftables
\part{First part}
\parttoc
\section{First}
\secttoc
\sectlof
\sectlot
Text of the first section.
\subsection{New subsection}
Text of the subsection.
\begin{figure}[h]
\centering A figure.
\caption{New figure}
\end{figure}
\begin{table}[h]
\centering A table.
\caption{New table}
\end{table}
\section{Second}
\secttoc
\sectlof
\sectlot
Text of the second section.
\subsection{Another new subsection}
Text of the other subsection.
\begin{figure}[h]
\centering A figure.
\caption{Another new figure}
\end{figure}
\begin{table}[h]
\centering A table.
\caption{Another new table}
\end{table}
\end{document}
